name: Infernium
location: Ardent Hope, The Brandfire Reformatory, The Burn, Deadlight Citadel
notes: An Infernium is seen caged in The Feral Gallery.
Inferniums and Skitterises both resemble Siege Crawlers, giant Daedric siege engines seen in Oblivion and Legends.
related_quests: Against All Hope: Launch an attack on the citadel of Ardent Hope and take on Valkynaz Nokvroz.
Dangerous Business: Kill the Unmaker and retrieve Daedric treasures.
Deadlight: Invade a lost realm of Oblivion that serves as Sister Celdina's headquarters.
The Mind's Eye: Kill the Unmaker and place seeing stones in the Den of the Unmaker.
Unmaker's Hoard: Kill the Unmaker and retrieve Daedric equipment.
summary: Inferniums are large centipede-like creatures that can be found in the Burn. They are often found in the presence of Skitteris, smaller forms of the infernium.
